coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

names: Mission Rock Terry A Francois Boulevard Paseo (Pier 48 entry)

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE but high confidence on three edges (recorded lot lines); the south edge is the Exposition Street lot line extended ~23 m east, which is where the plan's Exposition Street right-of-way ends at TAFB. Planned; today an interim roadway. ANGLE CHECK: check_geometry_quality.py flags a 12.3-12.6 deg corner here (its tolerance is 12 deg). Every vertex of this polygon is a real, recorded DataSF Assessor lot corner (see digitization_method) -- the deviation is the real lot's own shape (Bridgeview Way's paseo lot 8719A007 and the Exposition Street lot 8719A010 meet the park lot 8719A005 at a corner that is not exactly square), not a shear or a misread trace. Accepted; see docs/site-definition-of-done.md.
notes.digitized_from: DataSF Assessor lot lines: the north end of the Terry A Francois Boulevard lot 8719A003 between Block K, the Pier 48 lot 8719A001 and the China Basin Park lot 8719A005; named as a paseo in Mission Rock Design Controls Figure 3.1.1 (p.45), Section 4.3 (p.90) and Figure 3.6.1 (p.71).
notes.why_no_real_parcel: Part of the Terry A Francois Boulevard right-of-way lot 8719A003 (which also carries the roadway south of here and Channel Wharf); joining status.csv to it would paint the whole boulevard.
notes.regulatory_context: Design Controls Section 4.3 / 3.6: the TAFB terminus is a paseo facilitating park and water-oriented access to Pier 48, with a kiosk and picnic area connecting the pier apron to China Basin Park (Figure 3.6.1).

changes.text: The Terry A Francois Boulevard paseo at the Pier 48 entry added, between Block K and the pier, from the Design Controls' open space plan.
